name: ab_empty_axiom_audit_cannot_pass
title: An empty axiom audit cannot pass
text: Evidence completeness must be checked against a declared obligation inventory, not inferred from whatever evidence remains in the submitted audit file.
trigger: Axiom audit derives expected declarations from the audit file itself and accepts an empty selection
check: Bind a mutation fixture to verify_deposit.py::run_lake: replace lean4/CAQD/AxiomAudit.lean with comments only, then separately remove one expected #print axioms command. Both cases must fail even when build and Lean subprocess exit codes are zero.
